children: Gap is debuting a new fashion line in collaboration with boy band Just Your Type (JYT), the first under the retailer’s “Fashiontainment” platform to create content, licensing, and partnerships with its merchandise.

JYT is a five-member, “dance forward” boyband developed by Grammy-nominated songwriter Freddy Wexler and signed to Republic Records. The band boasts 2M social media followers and generated more than 450M views over the last 90 days.
In partnership with Wexler and Republic Records, Gap
will develop a “capsule collection” co-designed with the members of the band and will co-produce a multi-episode docuseries chronicling the band’s rise.
The collaboration will also offer live fan experiences and create content and activations across the platform.
The collection will drop in stores and online this fall.
The newly-created Fashiontainment segment is being led by Gap Chief Entertainment Officer Pam Kaufman.

"Gap has always lived at the intersection of style, music and culture, and our Fashiontainment platform builds on that legacy by putting our brands at the center of the stories and cultural moments people care about," said Kaufman. “JYT embodies the mix of music, dance, personality, fashion, and fandom that makes this partnership so exciting—and so distinctly Gap. Together, we can create something much bigger than a campaign."
While this is the first partnership under the Fashiontainment segment, Gap

has a long history of celebrity collaborations. The retailer featured a successful campaign with global girl group Katseye and more recently launched "The Hailey Jean" with model and entrepreneur Hailey Bieber.

title: Gap debuts fashiontainment partnership with boy band Just Your Type
